abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.7 | 4.3 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 8.8 | 4.4 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 9.0 | 4.5 | 550 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
